objective: FICHE_STRATEGIE v1 id: momentum_macd archetype: momentum_macd family: momentum timeframe: side: both indicators: - macd(fast_period=15, slow_period=31, signal_period=11) - rsi(period=16) - atr(period=14) entry: - long: cross_up(macd.macd, macd.signal) and rsi > 45 and rsi < 75 - short: cross_down(macd.macd, macd.signal) and rsi > 30 and rsi < 60 exit: - condition: sign_change(macd.histogram) or rsi > 80 or rsi < 20 risk: stop_atr_mult: 1.25 tp_atr_mult: 5.5 description: ATR stop-loss (1.25x) and take-profit (5.5x) constraints: - no_lookahead: true - only_registry_indicators: true

iterations.hypothesis: Combining MACD with RSI creates a robust momentum signal that filters out weak moves, while ATR-based risk management ensures position sizing adapts to volatility, reducing losses during choppy market conditions.

pre_reflection.text:
[Pre-reflection] This strategy risks overfitting to MACD+RSI combinations, which may fail in trending vs. ranging markets. The fixed RSI filters (45-75, 30-60) could be too rigid for varying market conditions. ATR-based stop-loss might be too tight given the 15m timeframe, potentially causing premature exits. The reliance on histogram sign change for exits is vulnerable to whipsaws in choppy conditions.
[Backup plan] If poor results, test with 20m timeframe and widen RSI filters to 35-85 for longs/25-70 for shorts. If mediocre Sharpe, increase TP_ATR_mult to 7x and reduce stop-loss to 1.0x. Alternative: Switch to a mean-reversion filter (BBands) instead of RSI, or use a multi-timeframe MACD confirmation with 1h chart.
